abstract:
Gas solubility data of carbon dioxide (CO2) in water (H2O) and aqueous sodium or potassium
chloride (NaCl, KCl) solutions were measured by means of the static synthetic method in a
temperature range from 313 to 393 K and pressures up to 10 MPa. The experimental data were
compared to the results of other authors and to calculated values using an equation of state
(EoS) approach. The calculations were enabled by the combination of the PSRK group
contribution EoS with the LIFAC method for the prediction of vapor−liquid-phase equilibria
containing strong electrolytes. The required interaction parameters were fitted to experimental
data from this work and from the literature.
